state.paragraph: Between July 11, 2013 and July 23, 2013, Party B, Party C and CSC/Pamplona engaged in a preliminary review of Mac-Gray and the potential acquisition opportunity. Also during this time, outside counsel to Party A and representatives of Goodwin Procter negotiated the terms of a confidentiality and standstill agreement, but did not come to agreement on the terms of the customer and employee non-solicitation provisions.
state.target_sentence: Also during this time, outside counsel to Party A and representatives of Goodwin Procter negotiated the terms of a confidentiality and standstill agreement, but did not come to agreement on the terms of the customer and employee non-solicitation provisions.

criteria.row_13: 06/30/2013 | Party C | NDA signed | Signed confidentiality and standstill agreement and received an informational package; instructed to submit a preliminary indication by 07/23/2013.
criteria.row_14: 07/06/2013 | Mac-Gray | Other material event | Denied Moab's request to partner exclusively with CSC/Pamplona for a rollover at this stage, permitting later-stage discussions so Moab's equity could be available to other bidders.

criteria.row_19: 07/24/2013 | Party B | Bid | price 17-18 | Preliminary indication submitted after the 07/23/2013 due date; no substantive diligence access yet.
criteria.row_20: 07/24/2013 | Party C | Bid | price 15-17 | Oral preliminary indication delivered by telephone to BofA Merrill Lynch; written indication followed on 07/25/2013.
criteria.row_21: 07/25/2013 | Mac-Gray | Round opened | Round 2 opened: Special Committee advanced Party A, Party B, Party C and CSC/Pamplona to management meetings and staged diligence, then revised indications.
criteria.none: None of the ledger rows records the event reported in the target sentence, either as the row's own event or in its note.
criteria.not_an_event: The target sentence reports no discrete event of these kinds (background, reasoning, description or discussion only).

match.instructions: `target_sentence` (from a merger filing; `paragraph` gives context) appears to report that a financial or legal adviser is retained, engaged, terminated or first shown acting for the target, a committee or a bidder. Each option describes one row of a research ledger as date | party | event | note. Select the row that records the event reported in `target_sentence`: same party or group, same action, consistent date and terms, allowing paraphrase and allowing the event to be summarised in a row's note. A related event with a different party, date or action does not count.
